notes.title: Announcement: Finally Released!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599632/74d768e1e2f28fd4c36cc01da52206d53bac0ce8.png"][/img][/p][p]Finally, it's time![/p][p]It's been a few years now since I first started game dev. Over the years I've initiated lots of projects, participated in so many game jams, but was never quite able to finished a single project for a full release by myself. It's getting discouraging, I was starting to question whether I have the ability or not to actually make a real "game" that people enjoys, not just some unfinished big projects that have "potential" for great things but can never make it out to the world, or a demo that people can play for several minutes and that's it. [/p][p]This time, I've decided to start small. I picked one of my game jam projects that I felt really fun playing myself, and spent some time optimizing and polishing it. I also implemented a new game mode with brand new machanics, and in addition to that, I reworked structure, put up a in level editor, so not only I can easily expand the game for further updates, players themself can also  share their ideas with some unique level design![/p][p]Again, I'm really excited for this, and hopefully people will enjoy this game as much as I do! [/p][p]I'll keep improving the game even if there is only one person playing![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much![/p]

notes.title: Announcement: About the Release Date
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone (assuming anyone sees this :)[/p][p][/p][p]To those who wishlisted, you might have seen that the game was initially set to be released on June 27th, 2025. That was indeed my original plan. I wanted to put out a demo for the next fest and then release the game right after, but the demo page didn't come out in time, so I gave up on that. Then the summer sale started, and the store page is now filled with big titles. I don't think it would be a good idea to release my tiny game at this moment if I want it to reach any audience at all.[/p][p][/p][p]Therefore, I decide to delay the actual date of release to July 12th, right after the summer sale is over, and I also get to work on the game a bit more.[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding![/p][p][/p][p]Truth Facer Games[/p]
